items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: But we have a director now, Beth Ann Kennedy, who really can connect.

ctx.x: Wasn’t there. And I called him up and he said, “Oh I’m just having my lunch.” He said “you know I’m going to play a couple of Christmas songs, right?” I said, “No.” Because he had no concept of this being a show and it’s quite different when you’re working with musicians and you want them to come forward here and, you know. But we have a director now, Beth Ann Kennedy, who really can connect. The first couple of directors didn’t really connect with the musicians as well. But they love it now and, you know, I had…

who they were seeing and hearing. And it was just gorgeous. And the next day I got a call from him, he said, “What’s your address I want to send you something.” And in it was his book that’s the Smithsonian interviews. It’s a gorgeous book, color and so forth. With a good add: To Anne, thank you, Ron. He’s thanking me. So that’s how much the musicians love it.
